Marsh Island

A remote wetland rendezvous beyond Vermilion Bay in Compromised's Gulf Coast storyline.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-27

Wetland rendezvous

The novel uses Marsh Island's isolated wetlands as the meeting point for a covert arms transfer beyond Vermilion Bay. [1]

Claim ledger

Every factual statement below must retain at least one traceable source.

  1. confirmed

    Compromised describes Marsh Island as a former wilderness refuge beyond Vermilion Bay, reached by water through surrounding wetlands. [1]

  2. confirmed

    The island is the location of the rogue arms rendezvous with Cassandra Raines and the Reborn, where the manipulation of the Gulf Coast factions is exposed. [1]
